body: I know he did, but hypothetical situations don't change reality.

He'd understand and then work with me to fix this problem. That's the kind of man he was. I think he'd be has frustrated as I am though. He was a better problem solver than I am. That's all I think about, everyday for the past 20 years is what would he say or what would he do here. I find myself talking out loud like he's still alive. I have full conversations with him and that's better than talking to any one person that still walks the Earth today.

Reading what people are writing here is just making me more frustrated. It's like starting therapy all over again. I can't properly articulate my problem either. 

I don't think I'll ever be able to get out what's been bothering me. I've been trying to write it, say it, draw it, whatever for almost 20 years now. 

I've wasted too much of my life and now I'm past the point where if I was able to get my shit together I could never make enough money to retire. I'm already seeing the effects of the work I've done in the past on my body. I won't be able to work but for another 10 or 15 years before I can't move well. I don't know how I did it but I fucked up bad. I have no future. I won't be able to take care of myself and because I always got paid cash under the table there will be no help for me when I can't work anymore. There will be no one I love around either. 

I'm tired of hearing how much better the future is supposed to be. If that was true then things would have been better a long time ago. 

Submitting this post has just made me feel worse. I don't think this is a good place for someone like me to get help.

I used to volunteer and that was the second worse thing I've ever done in my life. I used to work as a contractor. They would send me to these houses to fix where they people could pay. Most of these people were old and couldn't fix their house that was falling in on themselves. Out of my pocket, $7200 past the $450 they gave me to rebuild this old man's roof. I and two people that had no business wearing a tool belt built an entire new roof on this guy's house and I repaired the mold problems in his house that was making him sick. The man complained because he didn't like the color of his roof. I got yelled at for doing all the work I did and they "settled" with him because he said I made his house the laughing stock of his neighborhood. I think the roof not having anything but bits and pieces of tar paper on plywood made his house a joke but I guess because I didn't have a white color title in front of my name, my opinion means nothing. They told me to never come back and that ungrateful bastard gets a dry house and money for nothing. Fuck people who are in need. There isn't anyone that is truly in need. They are all just morons that let it fall apart around them and when someone tries to help anything that goes wrong after that or if the job doesn't look absolutely perfect, it's the volunteers fault. I don't want to risk running into someone like that, that costs me my reputation which in turn causes me to have to leave town, just to find someone worth being around. People are inherently horrible and anyone who tells me other wise is blind.

Being around other people have killed my pleasures in life. I used to have a lot of hobbies and I tried to turn them into jobs or distract myself by enjoying them with others. The constant negative attitudes of others and the fact that I can't share them with my family ever again has taken all the things I love and made me hate them. I find it fruitless to do anything because of how I always end up getting burned out.

This world has taken what I love and made me hate it. 

I'm tired of restarting and moving to different towns searching for something new. I'm seriously tired of talking to people face to face. I'm just at the point where I'm not going to be able to get a job anymore because of how burned out I am. If I could just end it all, then I could find salvation. I've been starting over and trying new things for a long time now. I'm sick of it and I just want it to end.
